current_affairs.title: Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA) between India and EFTA
current_affairs.summary: India signed a historic Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA) with the European Free Trade Association (EFTA) countries (Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, and Switzerland), securing a target of $100 billion investment in India over 15 years.
current_affairs.syllabus_relevance: GS Paper II (Bilateral Agreements) & GS Paper III (Indian Economy)

current_affairs.title: High-Level Committee Report on 'One Nation, One Election'
current_affairs.summary: The High-Level Committee on Simultaneous Elections, chaired by former President Ram Nath Kovind, submitted its report recommending constitutional amendments to synchronize elections for the Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies in a phased manner.
current_affairs.syllabus_relevance: GS Paper II (Electoral Reforms & Indian Constitution)

current_affairs.title: Supreme Court Ruling on Right against Climate Change Impacts
current_affairs.summary: The Supreme Court recognized the right to be free from the adverse impacts of climate change as part of the fundamental rights to life (Article 21) and equality (Article 14) while ruling on the protection of the Great Indian Bustard.
current_affairs.syllabus_relevance: GS Paper II (Judiciary & Fundamental Rights) & GS Paper III (Environment)

current_affairs.title: Household Consumption Expenditure Survey (HCES) 2022-23
current_affairs.summary: The National Sample Survey Office (NSSO) released the results of the HCES, showing a significant decline in the share of food in household consumption spending alongside a reduction in rural-urban monthly per capita consumption expenditure (MPCE) disparity.
current_affairs.syllabus_relevance: GS Paper III (Economic Growth, Poverty & Development)

current_affairs.title: Status of the Gaganyaan Mission and Astronaut Selection
current_affairs.summary: ISRO announced the four designated astronaut-designates for India's first human spaceflight mission, Gaganyaan, alongside crucial progress in testing the CE20 cryogenic engine for human rating.
current_affairs.syllabus_relevance: GS Paper III (Awareness in the field of Space)
